causal_quality_grades.A: official release, exact publication timestamp, live-observed

causal_time_policy.backfill_policy: HISTORICAL_BACKFILL may never populate observed_at with a reconstructed value; its available_at derives from published_at and it is labelled as such
causal_time_policy.date_only_policy: a day-precision item becomes available at the END of its day in the source's timezone, never 00:00
causal_time_policy.gate: an event revision is visible to as_of(T) only when available_at <= T
causal_time_policy.rationale: published_at alone proves when a source says it published, not when we could know. observed_at alone discards a real official release timestamp. The max of the two is never earlier than the moment we could actually have known.

timestamps.effective_at: economic instant the event applies to, when different
timestamps.ingested_at: instant the revision became durable in the store
timestamps.observed_at: first instant OUR collector saw the resource
timestamps.published_at: instant the source declares as first publication

causal_time_policy.unknown_precision_policy: excluded from causal queries; fail closed

dedup_policy.cluster_identity: cluster_state_hash(as_of) is a function of T
dedup_policy.clustering: as_of(T) clusters use only observations with available_at <= T
dedup_policy.leak_guarded: a cluster enriched by a later observation must not be visible at an earlier T

enrichment_boundary.degraded_mode: without an LLM the deterministic event remains valid
enrichment_boundary.reanalysis: appends a new enrichment revision; never overwrites

entity_identity_policy.fail_closed: an ambiguous mention links to no instrument
entity_identity_policy.linking: every link carries method, confidence and provenance

event_model.CanonicalEvent: causal cluster of observations describing one fact
event_model.Outcome: post-event market reaction; stored OUTSIDE the causal event
event_model.separation_rule: no outcome field may be reachable from an object a causal query returns

macro_surprise_policy.consensus_requires: its own available_at, provider and revision history
macro_surprise_policy.post_release_consensus: may never serve as a pre-release expectation
macro_surprise_policy.zscore_rule: normalising statistics use only releases available before this release; never the full history

market_context_policy.storage: separate artefacts, joined only by event_id at analysis time

missingness_policy.rule: these are distinct states and none may be encoded as zero

note: A design contract, not a capture spec. It binds the policies a future ingestion phase must satisfy; it authorises no provider, no network call and no corpus.

raw_first_policy.rule: no observation exists before its raw artefact is durable

storage_policy.decision: SQLite append-only receipts + immutable manifests, reusing the Phase 1C causal snapshot architecture
storage_policy.offline_replay: InformationSnapshot(as_of=T) rebuildable from raw with no network

taxonomy_v1.unclassified: GENERAL_NEWS is the fallback, never a silent drop
